title: Goddess of Victory: Nikke Game Gets New Manga Adaptation
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine announced on Saturday that SHIFT UP 's Goddess of Victory: Nikke game will receive a new official manga adaptation by Yokoshima Penguin this winter to celebrate the franchise's fourth anniversary.

title: New Live-Action Street Fighter Film Drops to #4 in the U.S.
content: Legendary Entertainment 's new live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series dropped from #1 to #4 in the U.S. box office in its second weekend. The film earned an estimated US$8,600,000 in the October 23-25 weekend, a 72.1% drop from its opening weekend earnings.
